selection_reason: Prefer the simpler direct-concatenation fusion because the single-split validation difference from gated fusion is very small and not supported by paired-bootstrap evidence of a stable difference.
reporting_constraint: This is a user/design choice based on parsimony, not a claim that Naive concat ranked first on validation.
main_test_policy: Evaluate each of the four already locked main-ablation checkpoints exactly once; do not tune from Test.
lodo_policy: Use only locked Naive concat plus 16 attributes, the frozen training configuration and seed 20260814; each held-out domain remains unavailable to fold preprocessing, checkpoint selection and threshold selection.
